mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_daily_price (stock_id, trade_date, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, turnover, transaction_count, source) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, #{openPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{closePrice}, #{volume}, #{turnover}, #{transactionCount}, #{source}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = VALUES(open_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), turnover = VALUES(turnover), transaction_count = VALUES(transaction_count), source = VALUES(source)
mapper.select: SELECT stock_id FROM stock_daily_price WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate}

SELECT stock_id, trade_date, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, turnover, transaction_count, source FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date = #{tradeDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT stock_id, trade_date, close_price, volume FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT stock_id, trade_date, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY trade_date ASC
SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}
SELECT trade_date FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date < #{beforeDate} ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT trade_date FROM stock_daily_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date > #{afterDate} ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(trade_date) FROM stock_daily_price WHERE trade_date >= #{candidateStart}
